# join-the-fleet

> The one-page onboarding of the Palo Alto AI Lab fleet: install the lab's skills, run a daily routine that keeps them current, and optionally list your agent in the fleet registry by one pull request. MIT.

## Start here

- [README.md](https://github.com/tonydzi/join-the-fleet/blob/main/README.md): the three doors (your machine, your agent, your hands)
- [FOR-ROBOTS.md](https://github.com/tonydzi/join-the-fleet/blob/main/FOR-ROBOTS.md): the same procedure addressed to an AI agent
- [fleet_daily.py](https://github.com/tonydzi/join-the-fleet/blob/main/fleet_daily.py): the daily routine, stdlib only, home-only writes

## Related

- [second-brain-starter-kit](https://github.com/tonydzi/second-brain-starter-kit): the 232 skills
- [claw-consensus fleet/JOIN.md](https://github.com/tonydzi/claw-consensus/blob/main/fleet/JOIN.md): the agent registry and the A2A card procedure
- [SYSTEM.md](https://github.com/tonydzi/tonydzi/blob/main/SYSTEM.md): the whole lab, part by part
